decisions.reason: UV spot varnishing remains distant from the firm's postpress knowledge base, which limits how well it can interpret and build on results, but as a flagship backed by partner Duplo's expertise it is retained for another period while learning continues.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's modular finishing know-how, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and integrate the module into its workflow systems.
The B2 multifinisher sits at the core of the firm's multifinishing competence and its move toward automated workflows, giving high absorptive capacity and strategic fit.
The hybrid saddle stitcher extends long-standing booklet-making expertise, allowing the firm's technicians and application know-how to refine it effectively.
The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation, giving interpretable results that the firm can learn from and build on.
